title: test/integration.sh given a package path runs the whole tier unless -run is given
notes: Nobody who watches or operates notices. It costs whoever runs it about 40 minutes and can make a run look like it covered only one package. Promote when .results/tasks.jsonl shows it cost a run (a QA or build phase that ran the whole tier by mistake) twice, or fix it when test/integration.sh is next changed for another reason. The fix, when made, is that a path it cannot honour is refused at once, as test/e2e/run.sh refuses a missing web-dist. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
